details: MARS SURVIVAL: LAST EXPLORER is an educational 3D exploration and survival game designed to make learning about Mars more interactive, exciting and accessible. In this game, players take the role of an astronaut exploring the surface of Mars. Their mission is to explore the environment, collect energy crystals, manage oxygen, discover a Mars rover and research station, complete missions, and activate a communication tower to contact Earth.The game features a 3D Mars environment with realistic-inspired landscapes, including red deserts, mountains, rocks and craters. Players can move their astronaut, rotate the camera to enjoy a wide view of the surroundings, interact with objects and explore different areas. The game also includes educational quizzes and information about Mars, such as its gravity, atmosphere, surface and environment.The main benefit of this project is that it combines education with entertainment. It helps students understand scientific concepts through interactive exploration rather than learning only from textbooks. It also encourages curiosity, creativity, critical thinking, problem-solving and an interest in space science and technology.The intended impact is to inspire young people to learn more about Mars, planetary science and future space exploration. It aims to make science education more engaging and encourage students to explore STEM subjects.The project is developed with the assistance of Google AI Studio and uses web development technologies such as HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with Three.js for 3D graphics. Development and testing are carried out using a computer and an Android tablet.The creative aspect of this project is its combination of a 3D survival adventure, space exploration and educational activities in one experience. Instead of simply reading about Mars, players can explore a simulated environment, complete missions and learn through gameplay.The project considers important factors such as educational value, user-friendly controls, accessibility on different devices, engaging gameplay and scientific accuracy. It is designed especially for students and young learners who are interested in science, technology and space exploration.
